item.title: Officials Urge Drivers to Give Snowplows Space After Multiple of Crashes
item.description: Adam Collins -- After a series of crashes involving snowplows across the state, Wisconsin transportation officials are reminding drivers to slow down and give plow operators room to work.

item.title: Sen. Johnson weighs in on ICE, budget talks during teletown hall
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) activity in Minnesota and federal budget negotiations dominated U.S. Sen. Ron Johnson's teletown hall earlier this week.

item.title: Master Gardeners to Present Rain Garden Program in February
item.description: Adam Collins -- The Door County Master Gardeners continue the Growing Together Education Series this month with a program focused on rain gardens and their role in protecting local water quality.

item.title: Rotary Club Scholarship Applications Open
item.description: Adam Collins -- Door County students preparing for life after high school have two opportunities for financial support as the Rotary Club of Sturgeon Bay opens applications for its 2026 scholarship programs.

item.title: Great Peshtigo Fire serves as backdrop for book discussion
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- You can explore the Great Peshtigo Fire from a different viewpoint as part of a book discussion hosted by the Kewaunee County Historical Society later this month.

item.title: Wisconsin hunters harvest 17,000-plus more deer than previous year
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- Door and Kewaunee counties followed the statewide trend in deer harvest numbers this season.

item.title: Heide’s new “Zen of Thieves” album connects past and present
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The newest album from musician and Northern Sky Theater co-founder Doc Heide didn't require him to look far for inspiration.

item.title: Preliminary plat approved for future residential development
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- The future of approximately 72 lots in the city of Sturgeon Bay took another step forward last week after the Common Council approved the preliminary plat for the proposed Heron Crossing subdivision.

item.title: City strikes deal for South 18th Avenue extension
item.description: By Tim Kowols -- A roadway you have likely used to access destinations along Sturgeon Bay's east waterfront near the Bayview Bridge will soon be under city control.

item.title: Austin Straubel Airport to Receive $4 Million Federal Grant
item.description: Adam Collins -- Green Bay Austin Straubel International Airport is set to receive a significant federal investment aimed at improving safety and efficiency across its airfield.
